nodes.summary: For all abelian groups $A$ and $B$, the group of characters of $A \times B$ is isomorphic to the product of the character groups of $A$ and $B$. Here a character of $A$ is a map $\chi : A \to \mathbb{C}$ with $\chi(0) = 1$ and $\chi(a + a') = \chi(a)\chi(a')$ for all $a, a' \in A$, and the characters of $A$ form a group under pointwise multiplication.
nodes.title: Characters of a product of abelian groups

nodes.summary: Every finite abelian group $A$ is isomorphic to its dual group, the group of characters of $A$ under pointwise multiplication, where a character of $A$ is a map $\chi : A \to \mathbb{C}$ with $\chi(0) = 1$ and $\chi(a + a') = \chi(a)\chi(a')$ for all $a, a' \in A$.
nodes.title: A finite abelian group is isomorphic to its dual group
